search.description.defaultMessage: Saisissez @utilisateur@serveur ou l’adresse d’un profil, sur ce serveur ou un autre.
search.description.description: Help text under the search field for a signed-in user, who can find accounts on any server.

search.description_signed_out.defaultMessage: Saisissez @utilisateur@serveur ou l’adresse d’un profil. Seuls les comptes que ce serveur connaît déjà sont trouvés.
search.description_signed_out.description: Help text under the search field while nobody is signed in: the server does not fetch unknown accounts from other servers.

search.description_known_only.defaultMessage: Saisissez @utilisateur@serveur ou l’adresse d’un profil. Ce serveur ne recherche pas actuellement les comptes d’autres serveurs, donc seuls les comptes qu’il connaît déjà sont trouvés.
search.description_known_only.description: Help text of the account search field while this server does not look up accounts of other servers (federation direction 'Send only' or 'Off', ADR-0006).

search.failed.description: Error under the search field when the search failed for another reason. {reason} is the localized reason.

search.label.description: Label of the search field, which takes an account's handle (@username@server) or the address of its profile.

search.not_found.defaultMessage: Aucun compte trouvé. Vérifiez l’identifiant ou l’adresse.
search.not_found.description: Error under the search field when neither this server nor the account's server knows the account.

search.not_found_signed_out.defaultMessage: Ce serveur ne connaît pas ce compte. Connectez-vous pour le rechercher sur son propre serveur.
search.not_found_signed_out.description: Error under the search field when nobody is signed in and this server does not know the account.

search.not_found_known_only.defaultMessage: Ce serveur ne connaît pas ce compte et ne recherche pas actuellement les comptes d’autres serveurs.
search.not_found_known_only.description: Error of the account search when this server does not know the account and does not look up accounts of other servers (federation direction 'Send only' or 'Off', ADR-0006).

search.rate_limited.defaultMessage: Trop de recherches. Réessayez dans quelques minutes.
search.rate_limited.description: Error under the search field when the server limits how often the user can look up accounts on other servers.

search.required.defaultMessage: Saisissez un identifiant ou une URL.
search.required.description: Error under the search field when it is sent empty.

search.sign_in.defaultMessage: Connectez-vous pour trouver des comptes sur d’autres serveurs
search.sign_in.description: Link on the search page while nobody is signed in; it signs in and comes back to the search.

search.submit.description: Button that sends the search for an account.

search.title.description: Heading and document title of the page that finds an account by its handle or URL.

search.results.description: Heading of the accounts found by name while their count is not known yet.

search.results.title.description: Heading of the accounts found by name, with their count.

search.results.count.defaultMessage: {count, plural, =0 {Aucun compte trouvé} one {# compte trouvé} other {# comptes trouvés}}
search.results.count.description: Read by screen readers when the accounts found by name change.

search.results.none.defaultMessage: Aucun compte trouvé. Pour une personne sur un autre serveur, saisissez @utilisateur@hôte.
search.results.none.description: Shown when no account matches the typed name.

search.results.failed.description: Shown when the search by name fails. {reason} is the error.

search.tabs.description: Label of the tabs of the search page, on a server with the search of posts: accounts or posts.

search.tabs.accounts.description: Tab of the search page that finds accounts.

search.tabs.posts.description: Tab of the search page that finds posts by their words.

search.posts.label.description: Label of the field that takes the words of the search of posts.

search.posts.description.defaultMessage: Trouve les publications qui contiennent tous ces mots, des plus récentes aux plus anciennes.
search.posts.description.description: Help text under the field of the search of posts.

search.posts.required.description: Error under the field of the search of posts when it is sent empty.

search.posts.submit.description: Button that sends the search of posts.

search.posts.results.description: Heading of the posts that the search found, and the name of their feed.

search.posts.results.count.defaultMessage: {count, plural, =0 {Aucune publication trouvée} one {# publication trouvée pour l’instant} other {# publications trouvées pour l’instant}}
search.posts.results.count.description: Read by screen readers when the search of posts has an answer. More posts may follow.

search.posts.empty.heading.description: Heading of the empty state of the search of posts.

search.posts.empty.description.defaultMessage: {scope, select, public {La recherche de ce serveur trouve les publications publiques, uniquement celles des comptes qui l’autorisent. Les auteurs peuvent la refuser dans les paramètres de leur profil.} local {La recherche de ce serveur trouve les publications de visibilité « Ce serveur », uniquement celles des comptes qui l’autorisent. Les auteurs peuvent la refuser dans les paramètres de leur profil.} other {La recherche de ce serveur trouve les publications publiques et celles de visibilité « Ce serveur », uniquement celles des comptes qui l’autorisent. Les auteurs peuvent la refuser dans les paramètres de leur profil.}}
search.posts.empty.description.description: Empty state of the search of posts: which posts can be found on this server and that authors can opt out. {scope} is the visibilities this server's post search covers: public, local, or public_local.

search.posts.failed.heading.description: Heading of the error of the search of posts.

search.posts.rate_limited.heading.description: Heading of the error of the search of posts when the server limits how often the user can search.

search.posts.rate_limited.reason.defaultMessage: La recherche reprendra d’elle-même dès que la limite le permettra.
search.posts.rate_limited.reason.description: What happens after the server limited how often the user can search posts.
